summary: Frontend-only test of the Quick Category Delete dialog (DeleteGroupDialog) at 390x844 as a Pro user (test_session_pro_1). I made a custom list TEST_CatDel with 2 categories: a long-named head with 3 sub-items (one sub-item is a long word with no spaces), and '2. Deck' with 2 sub-items. 36 checks ran; 35 passed on the first run. The 1 failure was my test reading the earlier 'created' toast. On a re-run the toast read 'Deleted 4 items' with Undo, so every requirement passed. Verified: the dialog opens even when 'Prompt on delete' is off (and also when it is on). The category and every sub-item are ticked by default, and only that group's items are listed. The note says 'The category and all 3 items will be deleted.' and the button reads 'Delete (4)'. Keep and Escape close it with no changes. Confirming with the defaults removes all 4 items, and Undo puts them back in the original order with indents intact. Unticking one sub-item unticks the category; the note becomes 'The category stays with 1 item. 2 items will be deleted.' and the button 'Delete (2)'. Re-ticking that sub-item does not re-tick the category ('Delete (3)'), and ticking the category re-ticks every item. Confirming with one sub-item unticked keeps the head with that item still indented; Undo restores everything. Unticking only the category deletes just the sub-items and keeps the head; Undo works. With everything unticked the button is disabled. Deleting a sub-item with prompts off is immediate, with a 'Deleted "Delta"' toast and a working Undo. With prompts on, a sub-item opens item-delete-dialog, and a single top-level item also opens item-delete-dialog (not the group dialog). Category deletes are saved and survive a reload. At 390px the dialog has no horizontal overflow: dialog scrollWidth equals clientWidth, the list does not overflow, and the long text wraps.

issues: The confirm button is meant to be red (bg-[var(--red)]) but shows navy rgb(15,23,42) because the .btn-solid background overrides it. This was already the case in ConfirmDelete, so it is not new to this feature. It is cosmetic: a destructive action would usually be red.

action_items: Optional: make the red background on destructive confirm buttons win over .btn-solid (e.g. !bg-[var(--red)]).
critical_code_review_comments: DeleteGroupDialog: with the category ticked, ids is head plus all subs; with it unticked, ids is only the ticked subs. This matches what the user sees. A kept sub-item stays indented under the kept head, which is correct.
removeMany Undo puts items back in ascending original index, which restores positions correctly. It is skipped if any id already exists, so a double Undo is safe.
Minor wording: with the category unticked and all items ticked, the note reads 'The category stays. 3 items will be deleted.' This is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created the custom list TEST_CatDel on the Pro boat during the test and deleted it at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build a category through create-list-btn (.first) with auto-indent on (the default): a numbered line like '1. X' followed by plain lines. li[data-testid=checklist-item-{id}] has data-indented='true' for sub-items. The Prompt on delete toggle checkbox is prompt-delete-toggle-checkbox (data-state). When reading the Sonner toast, filter by text; .last can pick an older toast. delete-list-btn only shows when the list is empty.
